name: v2_video_minimax_10s
prompt:
A hand grips a metal palette knife and slowly drags it through the paint blobs from left to right,
then pulls back and swirls in circular motions, mixing the colors together.
The palette knife scrapes across the surface, folding orange into purple into white.
Colors blend into streaks and ribbons with each stroke of the knife.
Slow, deliberate hand movement throughout. The hand never stops moving.
Top-down flat lay, static camera, close-up.
